mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a weakening in the housing market and broader economic demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST declines over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which increases corporate costs and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% over the previous month signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals increased economic activity and supply, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% over the previous 3 months, it signals a tightening labor market with increased wage pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200,000 and UNRATE decrease > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters and housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% over the same period, it signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 negative for 2 quarters and HOUST decrease > 10%
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 is negative for two quarters and HOUST declines by more than 10%.
